description: Generalitat Valenciana: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Generalitat Valenciana. Coverage: Generalitat Valenciana. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: ER Fotovoltaicas en la Comunitat Valenciana. Criterios territoriales y; Datos de autoconsumo de energías renovables; Energías Renovables Eólicas en la Comunitat Valenciana: Parques Eólico; ER Fotovoltaicas en la Comunitat Valenciana. Instalaciones: Líneas de . Formats seen: PLAIN, WMS, CSV, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
